description: File transfer from a Device to a Server
doc: Request a file transfer operation. Providing an URL where the device will upload a file with an HTTP PUT request, the source of the file to upload is implementation specific.

mappings.description: The URL to upload the file to
Keys for the HTTP headers, must be in the order of the values
Values for the HTTP headers, must be in the order of the keys
Encoding of the file or directory to upload
mappings.doc: Optional enum string for the file encoding with default value empty, other values are: [gz, lz4, tar, tar.gz, tar.lz4]

mappings.description: Flag to enable the progress reporting of the download.
Source from which the file should be read from.
mappings.doc: String enum specifying the source type, with allowed values: [storage, streaming, filesystem].

mappings.description: Source-specific information on what to upload to the server for the source.
mappings.doc: The value depends on the selected source type: for 'storage' is the ID of an 'io.edgehog.devicemanager.storage.File' property, for 'streaming' it's an empty string, and for 'filesystem' is a path of a file on the device.

Commands to execute before the file is requested. The command must succeed (e.g. exit code 0 on unix platforms) or the file transfer request will error. The following environment variables will be exported: $FT_REQUEST_ID as the file transfer request id, $FT_REQUEST_TARGET_TYPE as a value for the source type, $FT_REQUEST_TARGET as optional a value of the source, and $FT_REQUEST_PATH for the absolute path of the file

Commands to execute asfter the file is requested. The command must succeed (e.g. exit code 0 on unix platforms) or the file transfer request will error. The following environment variables will be exported: $FT_REQUEST_ID as the file transfer request id, $FT_REQUEST_TARGET_TYPE as a value for the source type, $FT_REQUEST_TARGET as optional a value of the source, and $FT_REQUEST_PATH for the absolute path of the file
